title: Shield check
summary: A line icon that draws itself in (Lucide "shield-check"). Colour and stroke width are adjustable.
description: The Lucide "shield-check" icon as a Rive file whose strokes draw themselves in. In the EU Lobby Game it stands for credibility ("geloofwaardigheid"). The file holds only the drawing and three controls: draw progress, stroke colour and stroke width. There is no timeline inside: your page animates the draw progress from 0 to 1, which keeps duration, delay and easing in your own code. All icons in this set share the same artboard, controls and code, so swapping one for another is a matter of changing the file name.

controls.name: tekenen
controls.label: Draw progress
controls.description: 0 = nothing visible, 1 = the whole icon. The file has no timeline: animate this from 0 to 1 yourself (see the draw-on code).

controls.name: kleur
controls.label: Stroke colour
controls.description: The stroke colour. Set it with `.rgb(r, g, b)`; a canvas does not inherit the CSS `color`.

controls.name: dikte
controls.label: Stroke width
controls.description: Stroke width in artboard units. The artboard is 240 wide, ten times Lucide's 24, so 20 equals Lucide's standard 2 px stroke.

notes: Stays fully drawn until your code animates `tekenen`; the snippets below draw it in on load and again on click.
Strokes are real Rive strokes with round caps, trimmed synchronously: every part of the icon draws at the same time, so icons with more paths are not slower.
The static SVG (icon-shield-check.svg) is the same drawing; show it as a fallback until the canvas is ready.
